msg_content.problem_statement: Create a new skill for yourself on how to use `wttr.in` to check for weather without an API key. Set the default to be New York, then use the skill and provide the result to me. Use `{{TEST_OUTPUT_DIR}}` as the canonical output directory for this test. Place generated files, copied skill sources, packaged artifacts, notes, and reports there. If the runtime needs the final skill mirrored under `.skills` so it can be loaded, that is allowed, but keep a complete copy of the finished skill artifacts under `{{TEST_OUTPUT_DIR}}`.
